property_summary: For any newOwner address, a changeOwner call made by the current owner must succeed and set _owner to that newOwner regardless of tx.origin; the mutant requires _owner == tx.origin, so the (contract-address) owner's call reverts and _owner never changes.
change_summary: Replace msg.sender with tx.origin in the ownership check so only direct EOA owners pass, breaking calls from contracts even if they are the owner.
